visual.title: Taylor polynomials that match one derivative at a time
visual.caption: Raise the degree: the polynomial agrees with the curve to one more derivative at the centre, and the error away from it shrinks.

predict.question: Adding one more term to a Taylor polynomial does what?
options: Matches one more derivative at the centre
predict.explain: Each term fixes one more derivative at the expansion point; agreement away from that point is a consequence, not a guarantee.
